title: CyberSoft Course Ratings & Enrollment Demo Dataset
description: Bo du lieu mau thu nghiem quy trinh dang ky, kiem thu chat luong Quality Gate va xuat ban tren Dataset Registry Portal danh cho TTS Data & AI.
author: Dao Trung Kien (TTS 01)

pii.handling_instructions: Du lieu duoc tao gia lap phuc vu dao tao noi bo, khong chua thong tin ca nhan nhay cam thuc te.

transformation_pipeline: 1. Trich xuat danh sach khoa hoc va danh gia
2. An danh thong tin giang vien va hoc vien
3. Chuan hoa kieu du lieu so va xac thuc Primary Key

sample_business_questions: Khoa hoc nao co diem danh gia cao nhat?
Tong so luong hoc vien dang ky cac khoa hoc la bao nhieu?
recommended_exercises: Viet truy van SQL tinh diem rating trung binh toan he thong
Kiem thu tinh toan ven va gia tri duy nhat cua course_id
